_about: Hand-written 'why and when' for carry-relevant items. Stats/costs are NOT stored here: they come live from data/raw/opendota/constants/items.json so they stay correct after patches. Keys = OpenDota item keys (also used for icons).

categories.farm: Speeds up farming. Buy early, skip if the game is already decided in fights.
categories.tempo: Cheap fight power for a hero who wants to fight early.
categories.survival: Keeps you alive long enough to hit things.
categories.utility: Solves a specific problem (evasion, ghost, dispel...).

items.why: Bonus damage vs creeps = easier last hits for melee carries. Sell or fold into Battle Fury.
items.when: Default start on melee carries; ranged often skip.

items.why: Cheapest sustain in the game. Eating a tree also gives vision paths.
items.when: Always.

items.why: Charges whenever enemies cast spells near you. A burst of HP/MP that wins trades.
items.when: Against spell-spammy lanes (Bristleback, Batrider, Timbersaw, most supports).

items.why: Stats, attack speed, armor for 500ish gold. Most efficient early agility item.
items.when: Agility carries when the lane is contested; one is usually enough.

items.why: Armor reduction + slow + heal reduction on hit. Makes melee carries win lane trades and chases.
items.when: Melee carries vs healing/regen heroes or when you need to stick to targets.

items.why: HP, mana regen, damage. Keeps spell-reliant carries topped up.
items.when: Spell carries (SF, Morph early) who want to fight before core items.

items.why: Attack speed + switchable stat. Tread switching (INT before casting, STR/AGI after) is free mana.
items.when: Default boots on most farming carries.

items.why: Damage + armor + an active speed burst. Better for heroes who must stick to targets.
items.when: Aggressive melee carries (WK, PA sometimes) vs kiting heroes.

items.why: Converts a creep into gold + XP every ~90s. Pays for itself in ~10-12 min.
items.when: Only if the lane is safe and the game will go long. Weak in fast games.

items.why: Cleave turns every creep wave/camp into one-hit clears; the regen keeps you farming without base trips.
items.when: AM and some melee carries in long games. Skip if you need to fight immediately.

items.why: Chain lightning clears waves and procs on illusions/Tempest Double attacks.
items.when: Arc Warden, ranged/agi carries who farm with right clicks.

items.why: Upgraded Maelstrom: huge attack speed + more bounce targets. Strong vs illusions and summons.
items.when: Mid-game DPS upgrade for Maelstrom users.

items.why: Constant AoE burn that farms by walking + evasion. Illusions also burn (weaker).
items.when: PL/Naga style illusion carries when they want to fight early, or vs illusion-heavy enemies.

items.why: Stats + 2 illusions + basic dispel on yourself. Illusions double farm speed and confuse targeting.
items.when: AM, PL, Morph, TB style agility carries. Dispels silences (Orchid, Bloodthorn) and roots.

items.why: Mana burn on hit (illusions burn too) + slow active. Shuts off INT heroes.
items.when: PL, illusion carries, or vs mana-dependent supports. Upgrades to Disperser.

items.why: Diffusal upgrade: strong dispel on self or ally + slow on enemy. Big agility.
items.when: Late game when enemies have many dispellable slows/silences.

items.why: Debuff immunity: most disables and magic damage stop affecting you. The #1 'stay alive in fights' item.
items.when: Vs several stuns/silences or big magic damage. Buy it BEFORE you think you need it.

items.why: Blocks one targeted spell every few seconds (Doom, Duel, Lasso, Hex...).
items.when: Vs single-target ultimates that BKB doesn't stop or that you must avoid.

items.why: Strong dispel + 2.5s of near immunity when you drop low. Stops burst combos.
items.when: Vs burst lineups (Lion/Lina/Tinker style). Bad vs sustained physical.

items.why: Strength + huge lifesteal active with basic dispel. Turns a losing fight around.
items.when: Melee physical carries late (WK, PA, Sven). Bad vs break/heal reduction.

items.why: Massive HP and regen that scales with missing HP.
items.when: Strength carries who must survive long fights.

items.why: Agility, attack speed, evasion. Enemies miss a third of their hits.
items.when: Agility carries vs physical cores WITHOUT MKB/Bloodthorn.

items.why: Huge stats (HP + mana + damage) and a slow/heal reduction on attack.
items.when: AM, Morph, Medusa style carries vs kiting or healing teams.

items.why: Active stun that pierces debuff immunity + passive bash. Lock a BKB'd or blinking target.
items.when: Melee carries vs escape heroes (QoP, Storm, Puck) or BKB carries.

items.why: Cheap bashes. Builds into Abyssal Blade.
items.when: Melee carries who fight a lot.

items.why: -6 armor on hit = big physical amplification, kills towers fast.
items.when: PA, TA, high-damage carries that hit hard per attack.

items.why: Daedalus: 30% chance for 225% damage. Scales with high base damage.
items.when: Damage-heavy carries (PA has her own crit, so less common on her).

items.why: Pierces evasion (80% chance) + bonus magic damage.
items.when: Vs Butterfly, PA (Immaterial), Windranger, TA's Refraction is NOT evasion.

items.why: Silence that amplifies damage + pierce-evasion chance + attack speed.
items.when: Vs evasion carries or a key spellcaster you must shut down.

items.why: Continuously dispels the target: removes Ghost Scepter, Glimmer, Eul's, Aeon's buff.
items.when: Vs saves and ethereal tricks.

items.why: Invisibility initiation + Break (disables passives).
items.when: Vs passive-reliant heroes (PA Immaterial, Bristleback, Spectre, Huskar, WK Reincarnation!).

items.why: Instant 1200 range reposition.
items.when: Heroes without built-in mobility (WK sometimes).

items.why: Blink upgrade that gives agility + phased speed after blinking.
items.when: Late-game luxury slot on agility carries.

items.why: Range + stats + disengage that still lets you attack the target.
items.when: Ranged carries vs divers (Arc, TA, SF late).

items.why: Cheap attack range + stats for ranged heroes.
items.when: Ranged agility carries; upgrade to Hurricane Pike.

items.why: Cheap attack speed component (MKB, Shadow Blade path).
items.when: Component.

items.why: Pulls you and the enemy together + Echo Strike double hits.
items.when: Melee STR carries who need to stick to kiting targets.

items.why: Agility + makes target ethereal (amplified magic damage, can't attack).
items.when: Morphling's classic burst item with Adaptive Strike.

items.why: Stats + status/slow resistance + move speed. A cheaper 'fight item'.
items.when: Melee carries vs slows and disables when BKB is too slow to get.

items.why: Lifesteal + attack speed burst. Fast farm on attack-speed heroes.
items.when: TA, Troll, Sven style. Watch out: the active silences you.

items.why: Spell resistance, HP, and mana restore from spell damage.
items.when: Vs heavy magic lineups if BKB is not enough or as a second defensive.

items.why: Resets ultimates and item cooldowns.
items.when: SF (double Requiem), Arc (double everything).

items.why: Aghanim's: changes or upgrades a hero ability (hero-specific).
items.when: Check the hero page; for some carries it is core (WK, Morph sometimes), for others skip.

items.why: Cheap ability upgrade, bought from the shop after ~15 min.
items.when: Usually bought around 15-25 min when it fits the hero.

items.why: Armor aura for team and -armor aura on enemies. Huge in push fights.
items.when: Late game carries vs physical lineups, or to siege high ground.

items.why: Maelstrom + AoE root active. Catches heroes in fights.
items.when: Arc Warden / ranged carries vs slippery heroes.

items.why: Ranged multi-shot + %HP poison. Late-game AoE right clicks.
items.when: Ranged agility carries late (Medusa, Gyro, Drow...).

items.why: Spell resistance + stats + HP + move speed stacks. Cheaper anti-magic option.
items.when: Second-tier defensive vs magic before BKB.

items.why: Silence. Shuts down an escape or spellcaster.
items.when: Vs slippery spellcasters; upgrades to Bloodthorn.

items.why: Poison + slow + armor on INT-scaling attack. Upgrades to Parasma.
items.when: Arc Warden style INT/AGI right clickers.

items.why: Agility, attack speed, move speed. Builds into Manta / S&Y.
items.when: Component.

items.why: Big HP regen for the price. Start of Battle Fury / Perseverance.
items.when: AM and Battle Fury carries, first item after boots.
